title: 5 Deportees Are Flown by US to Equatorial Guinea After they Resist Deplaning in Liberia
summary: At least five of the people flown to Liberia under the Trump administration’s third-country deportation program resisted leaving the plane. They were then flown to Equatorial Guinea.
